summary: Keyless (workload identity federation) credential for the untrusted PR gate: file the task now, later, or not

options.description: Hold; file after the gate proof run passes, with the operator doing the console setup

body: Problem: the gate's model stage reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an environment secret in ucvg-review behind a required reviewer (DEC-0404). A federated, keyless credential would remove the long-lived key. The model stage has not yet run end to end. Axes: exposure of a long-lived secret, moving parts before a first proof, operator console work. Research: GitHub, AWS, GCP and Azure recommend OIDC federation over stored keys for Actions; the usual order is to prove the pipeline with a scoped secret, then swap the credential. Whether to file is class (a); the console setup and any change to DEC-0404 stay class (c) with the operator.
